_comment: Copy this to pipeline_targets.json (gitignored, per-machine) and fill in real values reachable from THIS machine. Any field present here overrides that field in the matching {template_id}__v{n} variation BEFORE template substitution -- so it lands in the actual generated command string, not just the label. Every entry below is optional; omit a recipe entirely to leave it pointed at this repo's own docker-lab defaults. Machine3 (EXEC_MODE=direct, no docker exec) especially needs these -- the 172.x.x.x docker-internal addresses baked into pipeline_recipes.py mean nothing on a bare-metal box's own network.
